description: This file defines the 'Networks' class within the Thunder::Broadcast namespace, which manages DVB network scanning, parsing, and storage, including nested classes for notification handling, section parsing, and network data representation.

classes.name: Networks
classes.description: Manages DVB network scanning, parsing, and storage, including nested classes for notification handling, section parsing, and network data representation.

classes.name: Networks::Sink
classes.description: Implements ITuner::INotification to handle tuner activation, deactivation, and state changes, forwarding events to the parent Networks instance.

classes.name: Networks::Parser
classes.description: Handles filtering and processing of DVB sections related to Network Information Tables (NIT), and loads network data into the parent Networks object.

classes.name: Networks::Network
classes.description: Represents a DVB network with properties such as network IDs, frequency, modulation, symbol rate, and name, with methods to check validity and access properties.

methods.name: Networks::Scan
methods.description: Starts or stops scanning for networks by controlling the filtering of DVB sections.

methods.name: Networks::Id
methods.description: Retrieves a network by its ID.

methods.name: Networks::List
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the stored networks.

methods.name: Networks::Deactivated
methods.description: Handles tuner deactivation events, removing the tuner from active scanners.

methods.name: Networks::StateChange
methods.description: Handles tuner state changes, adding or removing scanners based on tuner activity.

methods.name: Networks::Load
methods.description: Loads network data from a DVB::NIT table into the internal network map.
